actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = "true" ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = "true" ]; then busctl --user set-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Temperature q 4000; else busctl --user set-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Temperature q 6500; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'if busctl --user get-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Temperature | grep -q 4000; then echo true; else echo false; fi'
